name: nulucre_score_evm
description: Score an EVM-compatible wallet (Ethereum, Base, Polygon, Arbitrum, Optimism) on a 0–100 reputation scale based on on-chain signals including transaction history, asset diversity, and protocol engagement.

arguments.name: chain
arguments.desc: Chain name: ethereum, base, polygon, arbitrum, or optimism (default: ethereum)

name: nulucre_score_stellar
description: Score a Stellar wallet on a 0–100 reputation scale based on on-chain signals including transaction history, asset diversity, and protocol engagement.

name: nulucre_score_xrpl
description: Score an XRPL wallet on a 0–100 reputation scale based on on-chain signals including transaction history, asset diversity, and protocol engagement.

name: nulucre_score_solana
description: Score a Solana wallet on a 0–100 reputation scale based on on-chain signals including transaction history, asset diversity, and protocol engagement.

name: nulucre_cohort_attestation
description: Retrieve the on-chain cryptographic attestation for the Nulucre baseline dataset, including the SHA-256 hash and transaction IDs confirmed on Stellar, XRPL, Solana, and Base.

name: nulucre_cohort_list
description: List all available Nulucre wallet cohorts with their metadata, record counts, and attestation status.
